summary: The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, arguing that it could lead to increased costs for schools and libraries due to the loss of funding support for broadband infrastructure. Brief Health research shows some individuals are affected by electromagnetic radiation The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding as a statutory authority. The text discusses the potential effects of microwave radiation on mobile phones and other devices, suggesting further exploration may have important implications for advising on safe use.
